# РЕШУ ОГЭ — Биология

> > A comprehensive Russian OGE biology exam preparation platform offering thousands of practice problems aligned with ФИПИ standards.

РЕШУ ОГЭ (SDAMGIA) is a leading online resource for Russian students preparing for the State Final Examination (ОГЭ) in biology. The platform provides exam-format practice problems, detailed solutions, and preparation materials based on official ФИПИ specifications. Users can drill specific question types, track progress, and simulate full exam conditions.

## Key Topics

- ОГЭ (State Final Examination)
- ФИПИ (Federal Institute of Pedagogical Measurements)
- Human Biology
- Text Comprehension Questions
- Type 24 Questions
- Exam Preparation
- Russian Education Standards
- Biology Problem Bank
- РЕШУ ОГЭ Platform
- Виктория Башкирова
